summary: Iter58 tested the accounting reorganisation and the iteration_57 fixes. Backend: the new /app/backend/tests/test_iter58_accounting_fixes.py passes 20/20. The iter57 regression suite passes 15/15 after updating one stale assertion on the TDS sections set. Frontend (Playwright at 1920x1080, SuperAdmin and Komal): the /bill tabs are numbered 1-7 and 8-13 correctly. Tab 13 goes to /reports-hub?dept=acc_tb. The Reports hub group '5. Finance · Accounting & Ledger Reports' lists all 10 accounting reports. The Trial Balance is tallied (8,04,000 = 8,04,000), and changing the FY or To date recomputes it: FY 25-26 shows an empty tallied total; To 15/09/2026 gives 3,54,000 = 3,54,000 and ageing TEST_V1 1,11,000; the default ageing is 61,000. Day Book, Journal Register, Payment Receipts, TDS (TEST_REF1 194C 2,000), GST In and GST Out all load. Excel export downloads acc_tb_all_all_<date>.xlsx and Print opens a new window. Tab 11 shows only ITC matching: itc-table, the itc-match-TEST_REF1 toggle (KPI goes 0 to 18,000, then restored), and itc-open-reports goes to /reports-hub?dept=acc_tds. Komal (Admin, designation Accounts Manager) sees the accounting tabs, COA, JV, Sales and the Reports hub group, and gets HTTP 200 on all 8 /api/acc GET endpoints. She can create a JV and a ledger, and deleting a ledger returns 403. JV Dr/Cr selects are 102px wide and readable. The customer state shows 'Delhi' from GSTIN 07. Validations work: negative JV/receipt/tds/retention returns 400, an account without a code returns 400, and a BRS clear date before the voucher date returns 400 with a toast in the UI. Vendor Bill calc-tds-section supports 194J-T and 194I-PM. One significant bug: the P&L and Balance Sheet reports show every amount as 0.

minor.issue: The check that the clear date is not before the voucher date uses the voucherDate sent by the client. If a client leaves voucherDate out, the check is skipped. The server should look up the voucher date from the entry key itself.

ui_bugs.issue: Every value in the Amount column shows 0, including Net Profit and the BS totals. Root cause: ReportsHub cellValue() renders col '_amount' as Number(row[cfg.amountKey]). accReports.js ST() passes amount=null for acc_pl and acc_bs, so it reads row[null] = 0. acc_ageing works because it passes '_amount'. Fix: give acc_pl/acc_bs amountKey '_amount', or rename the column key (e.g. 'amt' with pre-formatted inr) so it does not hit the _amount special case. Check the Excel/print export too, which probably shows the same zeros.

When the clear date is rejected (toast 'Clearing date voucher date se pehle nahi ho sakti'), the brs-clear input still shows the rejected date (01/01/2026) instead of going back to blank. The status correctly stays Pending.

issues: The subtitle still says '12 modules', which is stale now that the accounting group has been added.
The Vendor column shows the code (TEST_V1) instead of the firm name when the vendor code is not in /vendors. That is expected for this test data, but confirm it with real vendors.

With 'All FY' selected, the TB/P&L silently use the current FY start, so 'All FY' is not truly all-time. Picking a Month filter hides the statements unless To falls in that month, because the statement rows use _asOf = To. Consider labelling this or ignoring Month for statements.

action_items: HIGH: Fix P&L and Balance Sheet amounts showing 0 in Reports hub (amountKey null -> cellValue reads row[null]); pass '_amount' or use a different column key. Then re-verify Net Profit 99,750 and BS 7,03,750 = 7,03,750 on screen and in the Excel export.
BRS: validate the voucher date on the server from the entry key instead of trusting body.voucherDate; reset the input when a value is rejected.
Update the '12 modules' subtitle in the Reports hub header.
critical_code_review_comments: ReportsHub.jsx is 1350 lines; it should be split (dept config, filters, table, print/export).
accReports.js uses a module-level mutable cache and RANGE; setAccRange is called inside useMemo, which is a side effect. It works but is fragile; pass the range into fetch(range) instead.
Each test receipt or JV uses up an FY voucher number (receipts are already at AE/RV/2627/0007), so there are gaps in the voucher series. Consider this for audit, or reuse numbers in tests.
The Accounts Manager designation grants every op except delete, including 'a' (Cancel JV/receipt). Confirm this is the intended business rule.
